"""Fixed all-case paired reductions, independent means and preserved controls."""
from collections import defaultdict
from decimal import Decimal,localcontext
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from balanced_spatial_metrics import summarize
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V169-balanced-spatial-v3'
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');result=read(root/'scores-v1.json');old=read(plan['prior_scores']['path'])
assert result['component_forwards']==result['original_predictions_replayed_exact']==1644 and len(result['rows'])==6576
parents=[dict(r,method='parent') for r in old['rows'] if r['method']=='parent'];assert len(parents)==822
rows=result['rows']+parents;maps={(r['id'],r['method']):r for r in rows};summary=summarize(rows)
groups=defaultdict(list)
for row in rows:groups[row['kind'],row.get('present',row.get('variant',row.get('noise'))),row.get('cohort'),row['method']].append(row)
maximum_difference=0.;checks=0
for g in summary:
    selected=groups[g['kind'],g['condition'],g['cohort'],g['method']]
    for field,value in g.items():
        if field in ['kind','condition','cohort','method','cases']:continue
        with localcontext() as context:
            context.prec=60
            expected=float(sum(Decimal.from_float(float(r[field])) for r in selected)/Decimal(len(selected)))
        difference=abs(value-expected);maximum_difference=max(maximum_difference,difference);assert difference<1e-10;checks+=1
paired=[]
for endpoint in ['raw','EMA']:
 for method in ['balanced','spectral-only','spatial-only']:
  label=f'{method}-{endpoint}'
  for baseline in [f'V168-{endpoint}','parent']:
   for key,selected in groups.items():
    kind,condition,cohort,current=key
    if current!=label or kind=='real':continue
    for field in selected[0]:
     if not field.endswith(('DN16','gain','error')):continue
     if not all(isinstance(r.get(field),(float,int)) and not isinstance(r.get(field),bool) and field in maps[r['id'],baseline] for r in selected):continue
     pairs=[dict(id=r['id'],candidate=r[field],baseline=maps[r['id'],baseline][field],difference=r[field]-maps[r['id'],baseline][field]) for r in selected]
     a=float(np.mean([p['candidate'] for p in pairs]));b=float(np.mean([p['baseline'] for p in pairs]));delta=[p['difference'] for p in pairs]
     paired.append(dict(kind=kind,condition=condition,cohort=cohort,method=label,baseline=baseline,field=field,cases=len(pairs),
        mean_candidate=a,mean_baseline=b,percent_change=100*(a/b-1) if b else None,
        decreased=sum(d<0 for d in delta),increased=sum(d>0 for d in delta),equal=sum(d==0 for d in delta),
        maximum_increase=max(delta),maximum_decrease=min(delta),pairs=pairs))
save(root/'paired-comparisons-v1.json',dict(status='completed-fixed-allcase-reductions',scores=ref(root/'scores-v1.json'),prior_scores=plan['prior_scores'],
    summary=summary,groups=paired,independent_Decimal_mean_checks=checks,maximum_Decimal_difference=maximum_difference,
    new_neural_forwards=0,new_noise_draws=0,source=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text())))
for g in paired:
 if g['method'].startswith('balanced-') and g['baseline'].startswith('V168-') and g['field'] in ['template_gain','quiet_error_RMS_DN16','quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16','quiet_DC_RMS_DN16','full_error_RMS_DN16','block32_RMS_DN16']:
  print(g['method'],g['kind'],g['condition'],g['cohort'],g['field'],g['mean_candidate'],g['percent_change'],'decreased/increased',g['decreased'],g['increased'])
print('Independent Decimal mean checks',checks,'maxdiff',maximum_difference)

exports={};output=Path(plan['external'])/'exports';output.mkdir()
for endpoint,binding in plan['collections'].items():
 original=read(binding['path']);source=original['export'];assert ref(source['path'])==source
 state=torch.load(source['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
 config=dict(state['module_config'],balance_spatial=True)
 payload=dict(component='LateBalancedSpatialDetail',module_config=config,state_dict=state['state_dict'],parent=state['parent'],
              source_V168_export=source,operator=ref(repo/'src/demosaic/late_balanced_spatial.py'),kernel=plan['kernel'],
              endpoint=endpoint,step=1000,training_updates_for_this_operator=0)
 path=output/f'balanced-{endpoint}-step1000.pt'
 with path.open('xb') as stream:torch.save(payload,stream)
 restored=torch.load(path,map_location='cpu',weights_only=True);module=LateBalancedSpatialDetail(**restored['module_config'])
 module.load_state_dict(restored['state_dict'],strict=True);assert model_hash(module)==original['module_before']
 exports[endpoint]=dict(export=ref(path),source_V168_export=source,module_hash=model_hash(module),module_config=config)
figures=read(root/'figures-v1.json');records=[]
for item in figures['images']:
 p=Path(item['image']['path']);q=images/p.name;shutil.copyfile(p,q);assert p.read_bytes()==q.read_bytes()
 records.append(dict(item,original_image=item['image'],image=ref(q)))
save(images/'manifest-v1.json',dict(images=records,checkpoints=exports,operator=ref(repo/'src/demosaic/late_balanced_spatial.py'),kernel=plan['kernel'],
    source=ref(root/'figures-v1.json'),native_figures=72,native_triplets=24,no_resize=True))
helpers=[repo/'.cache'/name for name in ['reduce-v169-balanced-v2.py','audit-v169-balanced-v1.py','record-v169-viewing-v1.py',
    'finish-v169-execution-v1.py','build-v169-report-v1.py','publish-v169-balanced-v2.py','verify-v169-publication-v1.py']]
helpers += [Path(b['path']) for b in plan['metrics_sources']]
save(dest/'source-bundle-v1.json',dict(preparation=ref(repo/'docs/results/v169-spatial-balance-preparation-v2.json'),
    additional_sources=[dict(ref(p),text=p.read_text()) for p in helpers],
    fixture_relocation_source=read(root/'fixture-relocation-v1.json')['source']))
save(index,dict(status='completed-fixed-weight-intervention-audited-and-actually-viewed',preparation=ref(repo/'docs/results/v169-spatial-balance-preparation-v2.json'),
    initial_preparation=ref(repo/'docs/results/v169-spatial-balance-preparation-v1.json'),postprocess_preparation=ref(repo/'docs/results/v169-postprocess-preparation-v1.json'),
    copies=copies,sources=ref(dest/'source-bundle-v1.json'),figures=ref(images/'manifest-v1.json'),report=ref(repo/'docs/balanced-spatial-correction.md'),
    checkpoints=exports,actual_neural_roots=1644,exact_original_prediction_replays=1644,streamed_method_rows=6576,
    saved_new_full_predictions=216,saved_direct_correction_arrays=72,native_cases=36,native_figures=72,native_triplets=24,
    new_parent_DINO_forwards=0,new_noise_draws=0,new_training_updates=0,prior_neural_files_unchanged=90,new_neural_modules=1,
    CPU_tests=47,new_CPU_tests=19,CUDA_filter_checks=6,strict_transferred_endpoint_loads=2,scope=plan['scope']))
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
